title: Tarkir: Dragonstorm Promos: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Kin and clan call to me— and I will always answer."
All challengers were summarily silenced.
"Gravity is just a suggestion."
"Khan Alesha ensured our survival. Now we will forge our future." —Zurgo, khan of the Mardu
The Abzan forces rallied to the call, driving back Sarkhan's feral dragon horde.
"Come crackling spear, come beating wing! Come cavalier, come taut bowstring!"
"The Meditation Realm is a willful puzzle. Seek, and it will impede. Wait, and it will permit passage."
"Evil wears many faces. Keep your windows closed at night, or it might wear yours." —Sultai warning
"Once flesh, now gold and jade. Once dead, now alive again. Once respected, now honored beyond imagination."
As the rebels breached Qarsi Palace, she realized her time in power was at its end.
Vast sinkholes in the Shifting Wastes revealed long-buried structures—and long-buried dangers.
"Let the dragonstorms rage. Let what seeks sustenance feed. Let Tarkir be what it was always meant to be." —Sarkhan
Dragons of Tarkir are born fully formed, roars blending with the storms as a single, inseparable voice.
"Some days, you wish you were fighting a dragon." —Eshki Dragonclaw
"I've spent my life feeding Atarka's desire and hungers. It's time to see to my own."
The essence of Tarkir was shaped into draconic embodiments of the re-formed clans.
"You need not mourn. Their life essence has returned to the earth, where it will eventually bloom into a new form." —Kotis, the Fangkeeper
"The Twice Whisperer heals. The Dragonclaw protects. Together, we will rebuild the Temur."
"Through perennation, we stand together, families—ancestor and kin─united as one clan! Abzan!"
"A flurry of fists doesn't impress you? Perhaps if they're on fire?"
Differing philosophies were debated by bloodshed.
The Sultai approach was silent. The Temur response was deafening.
"We came seeking a challenge. It seems we must continue searching." —Zurgo, khan of the Mardu
"No one of us could have built all this alone. A clan, a school, hope for the future. Thank you all." —Narset, to Shiko, Taigam, and Elsha
They've attained a level of synchronicity beyond what's possible in a single lifetime.
"Each step we take is a decision that changes the course of our futures. We must be careful where we tread."
Scales streaked with lightning, trailing thunder in his wake, Neriv is the living banner around which the Mardu rally.
The Abzan believe in perennation—death is not only an end, but a return to the beginning.
When called to the land's defense, all come to protect their shared home. It's why many of the Temur use "family" and "herd" interchangeably.
"As you act, so shall you be judged."
She keeps watch for dragonstorms and rival clans alike. For dragons, she raises an alarm. For thieves, her blade.
"Hear me, Mardu! Our freedom is only beginning!"
It's as if the metal itself rages.
"Rage. Greed. Arrogance. People only accuse dragons of what they fear in themselves." —Sarkhan
Every spire is a physical dedication to the Way.
Built on a fumarole field, the village is a refuge of warmth amid the ice of the Qal Sisma mountains.
